newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico farm leader to meet Blanco to discuss milk.
newsitem.headline: Mexico farm leader to meet Blanco to discuss milk.

text.p: The president of the National Farm Council (CNA) will meet Trade Minister Herminio Blanco later Wednesday to discuss lifting the last remaining controls on milk prices, sources said.
Miguel Castro, the head of Mexico's umbrella group for agricultural businessmen, is scheduled to meet Blanco at 1800 local Wednesday/0100 GMT Thursday, farm sources said.

Mexico's one remaining control on milk prices is on the sale of one liter pasteurised cartons. Controls of prices of long-life or ultrapasteurised milk were lifted several months ago. The CNA has pushed for price controls to be lifted.
